cadence.rule: Scan on the anchor date and every interval_days after it, counted in IST calendar days. engine/cadence.py enforces this; a cron day-of-month expression cannot, because it resets at month end.

scheduled_task.name: Opportunity Radar Alternate Day Scan
scheduled_task.note: Fires daily at 08:56 IST. The cadence gate exits early on non-scan days, so the scan runs every other day.
